name: Cyberpunk 2077
quirks: Luma installs Cyber Engine Tweaks, RED4ext, redscript, ArchiveXL, TweakXL and Codeware when a mod needs them: by its files or its listed requirements.
Mods packed as just .archive or .reds files go to archive/pc/mod and r6/scripts.
Mod-managed REDmod files are deployed into the mods folder.
